Tornado Coming? Get Away From Windows - Your Life Depends On It
sources: National Weather Service, "Tornado Safety" (supports staying away from windows, going to a lowest interior level, covering the head and neck, and avoiding bridges) https://www.weather.gov/safety/tornado
FEMA / Ready.gov, "Tornadoes" (supports a windowless interior room, staying in the car with a seatbelt, and ducking below the windows) https://www.ready.gov/tornadoes

title: Your Fingers Don't Wrinkle From Water - Your Nerves Do It
sources: Wikipedia, "Wrinkle" (water-immersion wrinkling is driven by nerves and vasoconstriction, not water absorption) https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Wrinkle

PLOS ONE, "Water-immersion finger-wrinkling improves grip efficiency in handling wet objects" (wrinkles cut the force needed to grip wet objects by about 20 percent) https://journals.plos.org/plosone/article?id=10.1371/journal.pone.0253185
